title: Concept: npm client with TLS certificate validation turned off
description: .npmrc declares a client setting that disables TLS certificate validation, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: With validation off, any host that can answer on the network path is accepted as the registry, so the integrity value protects only against accidental corruption.
risk: With validation off, any host that can answer on the network path is accepted as the registry, so the integrity value protects only against accidental corruption.
